hero.title: More than an invitation.
hero.description: LYST brings event planning, guest management, interaction, and memory-keeping together in one place.

proof.title: This isn't a mockup.
proof.body: Data & Keti's event is already running on LYST with real guests. See what a published invitation looks like on its own link.

inviteLink.title: Every important detail of your event, on one link.
inviteLink.description: Guests no longer need to dig through different chats for addresses, times, and dress codes. Everything is presented in a polished, adaptive digital space that opens perfectly from any smartphone.

features.label: Adaptive digital invitation
features.body: From a single link, guests see the event details, dress code, host messages, and can respond to the invitation.

features.label: Personal link
features.body: Each guest gets their own link, where all details and interactions stay in one place.

features.label: Perfect on mobile
features.body: The invitation automatically adapts to smartphone screens, making it easy for guests to view it quickly and confirm attendance.

guestManagement.title: Guest responses and statuses, all in one place.
guestManagement.description: Confirming attendance is effortless, with no extra calls or messages. Guests can specify who's coming with them and share important details with you.

experience.title: Photos, videos, and voice messages.
experience.description: Turn your guests into co-creators of the event. With a digital disposable camera and voice messages recorded live, every emotion is captured in real time.

features.label: Event camera
features.body: Guests upload photos and videos directly through a disposable digital camera.

features.label: Voice guestbook
features.body: Guests leave voice congratulations and heartfelt messages.

features.label: Letters from the hall
features.body: Guests write letters that are gathered into one digital archive once the event is over.

features.label: Hidden Moments
features.body: Guests share unexpected moments, saved into a special collection just for the host.

archive.title: Gallery, voice archive, letters, and memories.
archive.description: Not a single photo or voice message gets lost. The moment the event ends, LYST automatically generates a digital archive that keeps those precious moments you created together safe for years to come.

card.title: Digital archive
card.body: Photos, voice messages, letters, and shared moments stay together as one living digital memory.

cta.title: Ready for your first event?
cta.description: Create your digital invitation today and turn a simple gathering into an unforgettable experience.
